name: io.github.A1-x-Tech/mcp-google-merchants
title: Google Merchant Center MCP
description: MCP server for Google Merchant Center (Merchant API v1): products, promotions, reports, issues.

environmentVariables.name: GOOGLE_MERCHANTS_REFRESH_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: OAuth refresh token with scope https://www.googleapis.com/auth/content.

environmentVariables.name: GOOGLE_MERCHANTS_ACCESS_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: Pre-minted OAuth access token (~1h lifetime) — alternative to the refresh trio.

environmentVariables.name: GOOGLE_MERCHANTS_ACCOUNT_ID
environmentVariables.description: Default Merchant Center account ID; tools can override it per call.

environmentVariables.name: GOOGLE_MERCHANTS_MAX_RETRIES
environmentVariables.description: Retries on transient errors (429 always; 5xx/network for reads).
